product_metadata.title: ROMOON Dresser Organizer with 4 Drawers, Fabric Dresser Tower for Bedroom, Hallway, Entryway, Closets - Espresso
features: Large Capacity: A good amount of storage with 4 separate drawers shows that you are able to fit about 12-15 rolled up t-shirts or about 6 pairs of jeans in one drawer; Made of Eco-Friendly material, harmless and wipe down easily.

Stable While Lightweight: Fabric drawer and strong steel frame with cross supprt bar behind create a sturdy and lightweight dresser, wooden handles attached on forward MDF board are more durable and easy-pull even under full load.

Perfect for Organization: Sleek modern yet simple look that goes with many styles, suitable for any place where you prefer to organize items; wood top match your other furniture attractively and can withstand up to 50lb.
Easy to Assemble: Package comes with all the tools and accessories for quick setup, taking about 20 minutes to assemble with detailed instructions and installation video.
Frame Dimension: 17.7 " L x 11.7" W x 36.4" H , Drawer Dimension: 15.59" L x 11.22" W x 7.8" H
description: -We are committed to developing professional products that make you feel comfortable at home.
A multifunctional dresser storage tower for every household

-Putting in closet to organize EVERYTHING - clothes, toys, belts, socks, hats and gloves to get stuff off the floor. -Using in nursery room to store extra baby clothes, crib sheets, diaper cloths and baby blankets, also a good option to store pump parts next to glider. -Providing additional storage space and convenience in guest room to unpack suitcases with great capacity bins.
What are you looking forward to?
It must be a smart solution to own a storage cabinet if you have tired of looking around for objects with hurried in a messy room.
Saving space in your room to make the most of the drawers of dresser. Putting in anywhere you need to, it’s a good purchase to teach your kids manage their items.
Everything seems to be easier with an organized way. Romoon products provide more possibility to create a relaxation way to organize your life.
